The Bobcats, led by fourth year head coach [[John Groce]], played their home games at the [[Convocation Center (Ohio University)|Convocation Center]] and are members of the East Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]].{{cite web |url=https://www.ohio.edu/building-directory/convocation-center|title=Convocation Center|website=Ohio University|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}}{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/coaches/john-groce-1.html|title=John Groce|website=Sports Reference|language=en|access-date=2022-09-29}} They finished the season 29–8, 11–5 in [[2011–12 Mid-American Conference men's basketball season|MAC play]] to finish in third place in the East Division. They were champions of the [[2012 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC Basketball tournament]] and earned an automatic bid into the [[2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2012 NCAA tournament]] where the 13th seeded Bobcats defeated [[2011–12 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]] in the second round{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/320760130|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012148/https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/320760130|url-status=dead|archive-date=February 1, 2022|title=Ohio holds on to shock fourth-seeded Michigan|website=ESPN}} and [[2011–12 South Florida Bulls men's basketball team|South Florida]] in the third round to advance to school's first ''Sweet Sixteen'' since 1964.
